attributes.description: Whether the data is differenced in the seasonality test
attributes.name: difference

attributes.description: The method used to deseasonalize the data
attributes.name: method

attributes.description: Whether to test the data for seasonality
attributes.name: use_test

parameters.description:
The period of the data that is used in the seasonality test and
adjustment. If None, the period is determined from y's index, if
available.
parameters.name: period

parameters.description:
Whether to deseasonalize the data. If True and use_test is True,
the data is only deseasonalized if the null of no seasonal
component is rejected.
parameters.name: deseasonalize

parameters.description:
Whether to test the period-th autocorrelation. If this test
rejects using a size of 10%, then decomposition is used. Set to
False to skip the test.
parameters.name: use_test

parameters.description:
The model used for the seasonal decomposition. "auto" uses a
multiplicative decomposition if y is non-negative and all
estimated seasonal components are positive. If either of these
conditions is False, then it uses an additive decomposition.
parameters.name: method

parameters.description: Whether to difference the data before testing for seasonality.
parameters.name: difference

signature: ThetaModel(endog, *, period: 'int | None' = None, deseasonalize: 'bool' = True, use_test: 'bool' = True, method: 'str' = 'auto', difference: 'bool' = False) -> 'None'
summary: The Theta forecasting model of Assimakopoulos and Nikolopoulos (2000)
